notes: Template-paradigm training split of OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents at tag v6.1, the same commit as the ovos-intents-v5 test split, so train and test share one label set. Rows are expanded per sample and carry the intent under 'label'; the runner registers each distinct template once. 14 en-US test labels (29 rows) and 31 rows in other locales have no training template at this revision; those rows cannot be answered by an engine that learns from templates. The en-US file is about 250 MB.
